text:
Aria Lopez: Small design review: when the toast appears over the dashboard table it overlaps the row actions and sometimes clips the ghost button focus ring. Screenshot: https://redwood-assets.example/toast-clip.png :point_up:

Tom B.: Repro on Chrome + Safari. Toast is mounted inside the table wrapper with position:absolute and high z-index. Also modal footer shadow seems heavier than other shadows.

a11y-bot: Reminder: focus indicators must meet 3:1 contrast and hit targets >=44px. Also toasts should provide an explicit announcement string (avoid plain 'Saved').

Jules Park: Proposed fixes: 1) move toasts into root portal with position:fixed and token `--toast-offset-top`; 2) add token `--shadow-modal-footer-sm` with softer blur; 3) update ghost focus token to 2px on dark surfaces.

Marcus V.: For z-index strategy, I'd rather lower toast to 1100 than raise menus; less likely to block dropdowns. We'll need migration notes.

Aria Lopez: Copy update: change toast copy from 'Saved' to 'Configuration saved' in config flows, fallback 'Changes saved'. Add aria-live and role=status.

Tom B.: I'll draft a small PR on `ui/patches` with tokens and a visual test for header/table combos. ETA EOD.

Jules Park: I'll add storybook snapshots covering dense table + toast + keyboard focus checks.

Marcus V.: Agree on lowering toast z-index and adding `pointer-events: none` to wrapper so it doesn't steal clicks on mobile.

Aria Lopez: Thank you! Small follow-up: can we name tokens clearly so teams can opt into the old behavior: `--legacy-toast-inline` and `--toast-fixed-top`?

Tom B.: Yep. PR will include token flags and a short migration note in the components docs.

Jules Park: Filed task: https://notion.redwood/design/1915000000-toast-focus. Tags: ux, tokens, a11y.

Aria Lopez: Great, merging once visual diffs look good.
